evidence_items.title: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
evidence_items.summary: Terminal X’s Eval Agent grades outputs against a 54-criterion rubric, catching 25% more deviances from a fund’s mandate with GPT-6.1 Sol.

evidence_items.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
evidence_items.summary: FairStress is a new benchmark that reveals demographic differences in how LLMs defend and explain their decisions, even when their final choices appear fair.
